text:
maria: Opening thread for MedSys POC — streaming works in their dev environment but in prod they hit early 429s and streams cut off when routed through their corporate gateway.
raj: Can you drop the client logs here? Need to know whether 429s are from our API or the gateway.
maria: Gateway returning 429 and it appears to strip Retry-After. Snippet: `GET /v1/streams 429` then gateway responds with `X-Proxy-Error: rate_limited` (no Retry-After).
alex: They terminate mTLS at the gateway, then gateway to outbound. Likely header rewriting or connection idle timeout on the proxy.
sara (sales): Customer asks if committed capacity would avoid this — can we offer Dedicated for the POC to rule out our rate-limiting?
olivia: Presales note: we can provision a small Dedicated pool for ~30 days (requires product signoff and billing).
maria: More context: their Node service uses fetch streaming with a proxy idle timeout of 2s, so long-running streams get killed. They see `ERR_SOCKET_TIMEOUT` after ~5s even though tokens were still being produced server-side.
raj: Mitigations: 1) ensure `Connection: keep-alive` and proper keep-alive settings, 2) send periodic whitespace heartbeats, 3) increase proxy idle timeout or route around the gateway.
alex: Critical: if the gateway strips Retry-After our SDK backoff will be ineffective — SDKs rely on Retry-After to schedule exponential backoff. If header missing we retry immediately and exacerbate rate limits.
maria: Suggested TS client tweak we posted to them:
```
// TS: longer socket timeout & backoff optics
const client = new Redwood({ timeout: 30000, retry: { retries: 5, factor: 2, maxRetryAfter: 60000 } });
await client.stream(...);
```

raj: Python hint:
```
# Python: read timeout & respect Retry-After header
r = requests.post(url, stream=True, timeout=(5, 60))
# custom retry loop: check response.headers.get('Retry-After') before scheduling next try
```

maria: Short-term workaround for customer: if they can't change the gateway, switch to polling (1s) instead of streaming until we can adjust routing or proxy. They still prefer streaming UX.
sara (sales): If we offer Dedicated for the POC, what's ETA from eng?
eng-runtime-bot: Small Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 can be provisioned in ~4 hours post-quota approval. Need org/billing confirmation.
olivia: I'll request POC Dedicated credits from product and cc @sara (sales).
alex: I'll open an infra ticket to reproduce header rewriting on corp gateways. Possible mitigation: encode Retry-After into `X-Redwood-Retry` if standard header is stripped.
maria: Also seeing intermittent 524 from the gateway (timeout) instead of passing through stream end events — matches proxy idle timeouts.
raj: We'll add an opt-in `stream_heartbeat` flag in SDKs that sends tiny keepalive frames every 10s for customers behind aggressive proxies.
sara (sales): Need a short security Q response: can we leave mTLS termination on customer side for Private deployments? They asked about key custody.
olivia: Answer: For Private we support customer-managed mTLS and KMS/HSM integrations for key custody. I'll add that to the security reply doc.
maria: Action items: 1) olivia request Dedicated POC credits; 2) alex open infra ticket to repro header stripping; 3) raj implement stream_heartbeat + docs and code snippets for TS/Python; 4) olivia update sec questionnaire note.
alex: I'll attach a small repro script that simulates a proxy rewriting Retry-After and dropping keepalive frames.
sara (sales): I'll tell the customer we have a plan: Dedicated POC option + SDK mitigations + security confirmation. Will keep them updated. :thumbsup:
maria: Following up with repro and revised snippets shortly.
olivia: Sent sec note to the sales thread, will paste copy here.
